pipelines.name: Claude Code Review

claude-review.if:
github.repository == 'grafana/gcx' && (
  (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
    github.event.pull_request.user.type != 'Bot' &&
    github.event.pull_request.draft == false) ||
  (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' &&
    github.event.issue.pull_request != null &&
    startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '@claude review') &&
    contains(fromJSON('["OWNER","MEMBER","COLLABORATOR"]'), github.event.comment.author_association))
)

steps.name: Find previous review

with.prompt:
Invoke the /review-pr skill to review
${{ github.repository }}/pull/${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}.
Invoke it as a skill; reading the file leaves its unattended-run
rules unapplied.

This is an unattended workflow run requesting Workflow delivery.
Review head: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_sha }}
Previous review commit: ${{ steps.prev.outputs.sha }}
Previous findings:
${{ steps.prev.outputs.findings }}

Return the structured review payload and publish nothing. The next
workflow step submits the review and checks GitHub's response.

What this run can do, which the skill cannot know: it reads the
checked-out code and the PR. It cannot build, run tests, write
files, or regenerate documentation, and a compound shell command is
refused one part at a time. Nobody can approve a denied command and
no other spelling of it is allowed either, so when one is denied,
review what you can read instead.
with.claude_args: --model claude-opus-5 --json-schema '${{ env.REVIEW_SCHEMA }}' --disallowedTools "Edit,Write,NotebookEdit,Bash(gh pr comment *),Bash(gh pr review *),Bash(gh api *),mcp__github_inline_comment__create_inline_comment"

steps.name: Publish review
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

fail() {
  echo "::error::$1"
  exit 1
}

# --jq prints a bare `null` and exits 0 when the field is absent, so
# an unreadable PR must not read as a head that moved.
head_sha() {
  gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" --jq '.head.sha // empty'
}

# The action fails the step itself when the session returns no
# structured output at all, so what reaches here is schema-valid.
# `null` is the session saying its correctness pass did not complete.
# GitHub requires ranges on the same diff side to run forwards.
review=$(jq -ce '
  .review
  | select(type == "object")
  | select((.body | type) == "string")
  | select(.body | test("\\S"))
  | select((.comments | type) == "array")
  | .comments |= map(
      if .start_side == .side and .start_line > .line then
        . + {start_line: .line, line: .start_line}
      else . end
    )
' <<< "${REVIEW_OUTPUT:-}") ||
  fail "the review did not complete: no review payload. Check the claude-review-transcript-${PR_NUMBER} artifact."

# The workflow appends the run marker, so tracing a review back to
# the run that produced it costs the session nothing to remember.
payload=$(jq -ce --arg sha "$REVIEW_HEAD" --arg marker "$REVIEW_MARKER" '
  {event: "COMMENT", commit_id: $sha, body: (.body + "\n\n" + $marker), comments}
' <<< "$review")

current=$(head_sha) || current=""
[ -n "$current" ] || fail "could not read the PR head SHA"
if [ "$current" != "$REVIEW_HEAD" ]; then
  fail "The PR changed during the review: ${REVIEW_HEAD} -> ${current}. Comment @claude review for a fresh review."
fi

endpoint="repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/reviews"
errors=$(mktemp)

if ! response=$(gh api "$endpoint" -X POST --input - <<< "$payload" 2>"$errors"); then
  cat "$errors" >&2

  # Fall back only for the one failure the workflow can fix without
  # asking the session for anything: HTTP 422 with an error naming an
  # inline comment location. GitHub reports that location either in
  # `errors` or in `message` alone, and it answers 422 for spam
  # protection and unrelated validation failures too. Those fail the
  # run rather than quietly dropping to a summary.
  status=$(jq -r '.status // empty' <<< "$response" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -z "$status" ]; then
    status=$(sed -n 's/.*(HTTP \([0-9][0-9]*\)).*/\1/p' "$errors" | head -1)
  fi
  located=$(jq -r '
    def normalise: tostring | ascii_downcase | gsub("[^a-z]"; "");
    if ((((.errors // []) | normalise) + ((.message // "") | normalise))
          | test("pullrequestreviewthread|mustbepartofthediff|diffhunk"))
       or ((.errors // []) | any(
             (type == "object") and
             ((.field // "") | test("^(line|start_line|start_side|position|path|comments|threads)$"))))
    then "yes" else "no" end
  ' <<< "$response" 2>/dev/null || echo "no")

  if [ "${status:-}" != 422 ] || [ "$located" != yes ] ||
     [ "$(jq -r '.comments | length' <<< "$payload")" -eq 0 ]; then
    fail "GitHub rejected the review (HTTP ${status:-unknown}). Check the PR before retrying with @claude review."
  fi

  # Keep every finding. Each one moves into the summary with the file
  # and lines it was anchored to, so nothing the session found is
  # lost because GitHub would not take the anchor.
  payload=$(jq -ce --arg sha "$REVIEW_HEAD" --arg marker "$REVIEW_MARKER" '
    def anchor:
      .path + ":"
      + (if .start_line then (.start_line | tostring) + "-" else "" end)
      + (.line | tostring);
    {event: "COMMENT", commit_id: $sha,
     body: (.body
       + "\n\n---\n\n**GitHub rejected the inline comment locations, so every finding is listed here instead.** Reviewed commit `" + $sha + "`.\n\n"
       + ([.comments[] | "- **" + anchor + "** (" + .side + ")\n\n  " + (.body | gsub("\n"; "\n  "))] | join("\n\n"))
       + "\n\n" + $marker)}
  ' <<< "$review")

  if ! response=$(gh api "$endpoint" -X POST --input - <<< "$payload" 2>"$errors"); then
    cat "$errors" >&2
    fail "GitHub rejected the review summary as well. Check the PR before retrying with @claude review."
  fi

  # Only now is the downgrade a fact worth announcing.
  echo "::warning::GitHub rejected the inline comment locations; the findings are in the review summary instead."
  {
    echo "### Claude review published without inline comments"
    echo ""
    echo "GitHub rejected the inline comment locations for ${REVIEW_HEAD}."
    echo "Every finding is in the review summary, with the file and lines it was anchored to."
  } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi

# Read the submission back rather than trusting the POST: an older
# review, another bot's review, or a pending one cannot stand in for
# this run's response.
review_id=$(jq -er --arg sha "$REVIEW_HEAD" '
  select(.state == "COMMENTED")
  | select(.commit_id == $sha)
  | select((.submitted_at | type) == "string" and (.submitted_at | length) > 0)
  | .id
  | select((type == "number") and . > 0 and floor == .)
' <<< "$response") ||
  fail "GitHub did not confirm a submitted review on ${REVIEW_HEAD}. Check the PR before retrying with @claude review."

# The review is published and confirmed against the commit it
# reviewed. If the head has moved since, that is not a failure of
# this run: it only means the newer commits have not been reviewed.
current=$(head_sha) || current=""
if [ -n "$current" ] && [ "$current" != "$REVIEW_HEAD" ]; then
  echo "::warning::Published review ${review_id} on ${REVIEW_HEAD}. The head is now ${current}; those commits are unreviewed. Comment @claude review for a fresh review."
  exit 0
fi

echo "Published review ${review_id} on ${REVIEW_HEAD}"

pipelines.name: Publish gcx.wasm

steps.name: Resolve the ref to publish
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${SANDBOX_VERSION:-}" ]; then
  echo "ref=$GITHUB_REF" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
elif [[ "$SANDBOX_VERSION" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]; then
  echo "ref=refs/tags/experimental/sandbox/$SANDBOX_VERSION" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "::error::sandbox_version must look like v1.2.3, got: $SANDBOX_VERSION"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Push by digest
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'FROM scratch\nCOPY gcx.wasm gcx.commit /\nCOPY cache /cache\n' >"$IMAGE_DIR/Dockerfile"
echo "$GHCR_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io --username "$GITHUB_ACTOR" --password-stdin
docker buildx create --use --driver docker-container >/dev/null
# zstd -19 roughly halves the gzip size (about 100 MB to 47 MB per
# platform), and it is paid once here rather than on every pull.
docker buildx build \
  --platform "$PLATFORM" \
  --provenance=false \
  --label "org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/grafana/gcx" \
  --label "org.opencontainers.image.revision=$COMMIT" \
  --metadata-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/metadata.json" \
  --output "type=image,name=$IMAGE,push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true,compression=zstd,compression-level=19,oci-mediatypes=true" \
  "$IMAGE_DIR"
mkdir -p "$DIGEST_DIR"
jq -r '."containerimage.digest"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/metadata.json" >"$DIGEST_DIR/${PLATFORM//\//-}"

steps.name: Create and push the index
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
tags=(--tag "$IMAGE:sha-$COMMIT" --tag "$IMAGE:sha-${COMMIT:0:12}")
case "$REF" in
refs/heads/main) tags+=(--tag "$IMAGE:main") ;;
refs/tags/experimental/sandbox/v*) tags+=(--tag "$IMAGE:sandbox-${REF#refs/tags/experimental/sandbox/}") ;;
esac
sources=()
for f in "$DIGEST_DIR"/*; do sources+=("$IMAGE@$(cat "$f")"); done

echo "$GHCR_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io --username "$GITHUB_ACTOR" --password-stdin
docker buildx imagetools create \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/grafana/gcx" \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.revision=$COMMIT" \
  "${tags[@]}" \
  "${sources[@]}"
docker buildx imagetools inspect "$IMAGE:sha-$COMMIT"

pipelines.name: Publish Homebrew Formula

steps.name: Resolve tag and pre-release guard
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -z "${TAG}" ]]; then
  echo "::warning::no tag provided; skipping"
  echo "skip=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ "${TAG}" != v* ]]; then
  echo "Input '${TAG}' is not a release tag; skipping"
  echo "skip=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ "${TAG}" == *-* ]]; then
  echo "Tag '${TAG}' is a pre-release (contains '-'); skipping tap publication"
  echo "skip=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  exit 0
fi
VERSION="${TAG#v}"
{
  echo "version=${VERSION}"
  echo "branch=gcx-${VERSION}"
  echo "skip=false"
} >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

steps.name: Compute source tarball sha256
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
TARBALL_URL="https://github.com/${GH_REPO}/archive/refs/tags/${TAG}.tar.gz"
echo "Fetching: ${TARBALL_URL}"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o source.tar.gz "${TARBALL_URL}"
SHA256="$(sha256sum source.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')"
if [[ ! "${SHA256}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::computed sha256 is not 64 hex chars: '${SHA256}'"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Computed sha256=${SHA256}"
echo "sha256=${SHA256}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

steps.name: Render formula from template
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
TMPL=".github/homebrew/gcx.rb.tmpl"
if [[ ! -f "${TMPL}" ]]; then
  echo "::error::template missing at ${TMPL}"
  exit 1
fi
envsubst '$VERSION $SHA256' < "${TMPL}" > gcx.rb
# Sanity-check the rendered formula:
grep -q "^class Gcx < Formula" gcx.rb \
  || { echo "::error::bad formula render (missing class header)"; exit 1; }
grep -q "sha256 \"${SHA256}\"" gcx.rb \
  || { echo "::error::sha256 not substituted"; exit 1; }
grep -q "/archive/refs/tags/v${VERSION}.tar.gz" gcx.rb \
  || { echo "::error::version not substituted into URL"; exit 1; }
echo "Rendered gcx.rb:"
echo "---"
cat gcx.rb
echo "---"
echo "rb_path=${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/gcx.rb" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

steps.name: Open tap pull request
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

DEFAULT_BRANCH="$(gh api "repos/${TAP_REPO}" --jq .default_branch)"
BASE_SHA="$(gh api "repos/${TAP_REPO}/git/ref/heads/${DEFAULT_BRANCH}" --jq .object.sha)"

# Idempotency: if gcx.rb already matches on the default branch, the
# formula for this version is already published — nothing to do.
NEW_HASH="$(sha256sum "${RB_PATH}" | awk '{print $1}')"
CURRENT_HASH="$(gh api "repos/${TAP_REPO}/contents/gcx.rb?ref=${DEFAULT_BRANCH}" --jq '.content' 2>/dev/null \
  | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
if [[ "${NEW_HASH}" == "${CURRENT_HASH}" ]]; then
  echo "gcx.rb on ${DEFAULT_BRANCH} already matches gcx ${VERSION}; nothing to do."
  exit 0
fi

# Create (or reset to the default-branch tip) the release branch.
if gh api "repos/${TAP_REPO}/git/ref/heads/${BRANCH}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gh api -X PATCH "repos/${TAP_REPO}/git/refs/heads/${BRANCH}" \
    -f sha="${BASE_SHA}" -F force=true >/dev/null
else
  gh api -X POST "repos/${TAP_REPO}/git/refs" \
    -f ref="refs/heads/${BRANCH}" -f sha="${BASE_SHA}" >/dev/null
fi

# Current gcx.rb blob SHA on the branch (required to update an
# existing file via the Contents API).
FILE_SHA="$(gh api "repos/${TAP_REPO}/contents/gcx.rb?ref=${BRANCH}" --jq '.sha' 2>/dev/null || true)"

# Commit via the Contents API rather than a local `git commit` +
# `git push`. Commits created through the API are signed with
# GitHub's web-flow key and so count as "verified", satisfying the
# tap's required-signature rule — a plain push from the runner is
# unsigned and gets rejected (GH013).
# Flat-layout tap: gcx.rb lives at the repo root, next to alloy.rb /
# grafana.rb — NOT under Casks/.
PUT_ARGS=(-X PUT "repos/${TAP_REPO}/contents/gcx.rb"
  -f message="gcx ${VERSION}"
  -f content="$(base64 -w0 "${RB_PATH}")"
  -f branch="${BRANCH}")
if [[ -n "${FILE_SHA}" ]]; then
  PUT_ARGS+=(-f sha="${FILE_SHA}")
fi
gh api "${PUT_ARGS[@]}" >/dev/null

EXISTING_PR="$(gh pr list \
    --repo "${TAP_REPO}" \
    --head "${BRANCH}" \
    --state all \
    --json number \
    --jq '.[0].number // empty')"

if [[ -n "${EXISTING_PR}" ]]; then
  echo "PR #${EXISTING_PR} already open for ${BRANCH}; updated branch in place."
  exit 0
fi

gh pr create \
  --repo "${TAP_REPO}" \
  --base "${DEFAULT_BRANCH}" \
  --head "${BRANCH}" \
  --title "gcx ${VERSION}" \
  --body "Automated formula bump for [gcx ${VERSION}](https://github.com/grafana/gcx/releases/tag/v${VERSION}). Generated by the gcx release pipeline."
